data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Irish name Torrán meaning 'thunder' or 'little warrior'. In Irish mythology, Thor was the god of thunder, and the name Torrin reflects this connection. The name Torrin carries the meaning “Thunder, little warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Torrin usually hope their child will grow to embody thunder, little warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
